definitions.explanation: The forceful release of liquid, gas, or material from an opening. Used for volcanoes, geysers, pipes, and other physical phenomena.

definitions.gloss: outpouring; surge; flood (of complaints, problems, etc.)
definitions.explanation: Figuratively, a sudden and overwhelming emergence of problems, complaints, or other abstract things.

examples.japanese: {火山|かざん}からマグマが{噴出|ふんしゅつ}した。
{水道管|すいどうかん}が{破裂|はれつ}して{水|みず}が{噴出|ふんしゅつ}した。
examples.english: The water pipe burst and water gushed out.

examples.japanese: {地下|ちか}から{温泉|おんせん}が{勢|いきお}いよく{噴出|ふんしゅつ}している。
examples.english: Hot spring water is gushing up forcefully from underground.

examples.japanese: {不満|ふまん}が{噴出|ふんしゅつ}した。
{新|あたら}しい{制度|せいど}に{対|たい}して{問題|もんだい}が{次々|つぎつぎ}と{噴出|ふんしゅつ}している。
examples.english: Problems are erupting one after another with the new system.

examples.japanese: {社長|しゃちょう}の{辞任|じにん}{後|ご}、{社内|しゃない}から{長年|ながねん}の{不満|ふまん}が{一気|いっき}に{噴出|ふんしゅつ}した。
examples.english: After the CEO's resignation, years of internal grievances poured out all at once.

notes:
USAGE:
Used with する as a verb. The figurative use (sense 2) is very common in news and business contexts, especially for complaints and problems that have been building up.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- マグマが{噴出|ふんしゅつ}する (magma erupts)
- {不満|ふまん}が{噴出|ふんしゅつ}する (complaints erupt)
- {問題|もんだい}が{噴出|ふんしゅつ}する (problems surge forth)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {噴火|ふんか}: volcanic eruption — specifically for volcanoes
- {流出|りゅうしゅつ}: outflow, leak — a more gradual release
